title: Fix Tdarr Matrix Finding Selection
summary: Fix the Tdarr Matrix findings table checkbox selection so selecting cases does not bubble into the row detail click handler.
reason: The Diagnostics console select control on finding rows appeared clickable but did not reliably select rows for targeted rerun.
behavior_before: Clicking a Tdarr Matrix finding checkbox could bubble to the row click handler and re-render the table before the selection state was visible.
behavior_after: Checkbox clicks stay inside the checkbox control, update the selected finding key set, and leave row-detail selection as a separate interaction.
tests_added: tests/webview/test_webview_frontend_mutation_boundary.py asserts Tdarr Matrix finding checkbox clicks and select-cell clicks are handled separately from row clicks
rollback_plan: Remove the checkbox click event boundary and related static test, then refresh summaries and rerun WebView mutation-boundary tests.
notes:
Keep rerun payloads keyed-only; do not add frontend path submission.
Fixed Tdarr Matrix finding checkbox selection event handling and added static regression coverage.
